Name: Gendered Farmer Hurt Sounds (CHOOSE ONLY ONE)
Author: FuwaDoku
Description:
[b]"Farmer Pain Sounds Overhaul – Pick Your Flavor of Oof!"[/b]

Ever wondered why your farmer sounds like they just let out the most disappointing burp in existence every time they take damage? Well, wonder no more! This mod replaces the default "hurt" sound with four new variants, so your farmer can finally express their agony in a way that actually makes sense (or doesn't, depending on your vibe).

[b]Choose from the following beautifully curated sound options:
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Femboy[/b] – Delicate boy sounds that makes you question if your farmer actually got hurt or is auditioning for a Hentai video.


[*][b]Manly[/b] – The guttural, testosterone-fueled grunt of a man who just stubbed his toe but refuses to cry.


[*][b]Tomboy[/b] – An array of grunts that sound like they're trying to say "Yeah, that hurt, but now I'll beat your ass."


[*][b]Girly[/b] – Perfect for when you want your farmer to sound like they feel BONITA.
[/list]
[b]Customization FTW![/b]
Feeling spicy? Want your farmer to break gender norms with their pain sounds? You can mix and match freely! Whether you want your male farmer to let out an anime uwu squeal or your farmgirl to grunt like she just bench-pressed the whole town, this mod’s got you covered.[b]

Installation:[/b]
Just pick your preferred pain flavor, drop it in the mods folder, and prepare to take damage like never before!

[i][size=1]P.S: Okay, maybe I added more than what I initially wanted to. But hey, more variety = more fun, right?[/size][/i]
